name: aqp-scim-outbound
description: Outbound SCIM provisioning to AWS IAM Identity Center + Microsoft Graph (Entra). Skeleton; payloads land in a follow-up PR. Per the always-on aqp-management-engine rule the Action MUST NOT log secret values.

secrets.name: SCIM_AWS_BEARER
secrets.description: AWS IAM Identity Center SCIM bearer token. Provisioned + rotated via AWS Secrets Manager; injected into the Action via Terraform from the auth0_action.scim-outbound module.

secrets.name: SCIM_AWS_TENANT_URL
secrets.description: AWS IAM Identity Center SCIM endpoint base URL, e.g. https://scim.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/<tenant>/scim/v2.

secrets.name: GRAPH_TENANT_ID
secrets.description: Microsoft Entra tenant id used to compose the Graph token endpoint.

secrets.name: GRAPH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Microsoft Graph app-reg client id (User.ReadWrite.All + Directory.ReadWrite.All).

secrets.name: GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Microsoft Graph app-reg client secret. Rotated quarterly via Azure Key Vault; injected via Terraform.
